verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a built-in knowledge base, document upload, or RAG feature for grounding Vapi assistants on a developer's own content. Custom webhook tools, dynamic variables and personalization are adjacent building blocks, not a built-in knowledge base. The CLI's IDE-knowledge feature concerns Vapi's own APIs, not user documents.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content
